inputs.name: control_planes
inputs.description: Control plane nodes, by name: a map of names to addresses, or to host objects with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file or jump_hosts. Names become node names. The first name in sorted order runs kubeadm init.

inputs.name: workers
inputs.description: Worker nodes, by name, in the same form as control_planes. A name can't be both a control plane and a worker.

inputs.name: first_control_plane
inputs.description: Control plane that runs kubeadm init. When null, the first name in sorted order. Keep it the same for the life of the cluster: adding a control plane whose name sorts first would otherwise run kubeadm init on it.

inputs.name: join_token
inputs.description: Bootstrap token nodes join with, in kubeadm's form: 6 and 16 characters from a-z and 0-9, joined by a dot. kubeadm token generate makes one.

inputs.name: certificate_key
inputs.description: Key that encrypts the control plane certificates kubeadm shares with joining control planes: 64 hex characters, such as from kubeadm certs certificate-key.

inputs.name: kubernetes_version
inputs.description: Kubernetes minor version, such as "1.37". Nodes get the newest patch release of it from pkgs.k8s.io.

inputs.name: control_plane_endpoint
inputs.description: Address and port of the Kubernetes API, such as a load balancer or a virtual IP. When null, the first control plane's address and port 6443.

inputs.name: pod_cidr
inputs.description: Pod network. The default is the one Flannel expects.

inputs.name: cni_manifest_url
inputs.description: Manifest of the pod network to apply after kubeadm init. Set null to install one yourself, as with Cilium's CLI or a Helm chart.

inputs.name: ignore_preflight_errors
inputs.description: kubeadm preflight checks to treat as warnings, such as ["SystemVerification"]. Swap is always one, since the kubelet runs with failSwapOn false.
